main_text.l: II. Ad finem Author proparaturus, incipit à voto, cujus hæc forma: ὁ δὲ θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης, καταρτίσαι ὑμᾶς ἐν παντὶ ἔργῳ ἀγαθῷ &c. subjuncta doxologiâ, διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ᾧ ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων, ἀμήν. Hebr. XIII.20,21. Simili, inquam, & voto & δοξολογία, Paulus colophonem imponere solet Epistolis. Sic priori ad Thessaloni-censes, Αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ Θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης, ἁγιάσαι ὑμᾶς ὁλοτελεῖς &c. 1. Thess. v.22. Sic posteriori Epistolâ, αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης δώη ὑμῖν &c. 2. Thess. iii.16. Similis clausa Epistolæ ad Romanos, cum voto de confirmandis iis per illius Evangelium &c. eâdem δοξο-λογία terminando, Rom. xvi.25,27. Idem in Epistolâ ad Philippenses, ubi præmisso voto de adimplendâ in Philippensibus gratiâ, simili δοξολογία claudit, Philipp. iv.19,20. Quibus, solus Petrus affine quid habet, Epistolâ priori.
III. Subjungit Author salutationem, Paulo ubiq; ferè solitam usurpari. Ἀσπάζονται τοὺς ἡγουμένους ὑμῶν, καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἁ-γίους. Ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς οἱ ἀπὸ τῆς Ἰταλίας. Hebr. XIII.24.

page.notes: The Greek and the italic Greek words are copied as far as legible; the Greek on the first line of section III and the words after "ἀπὸ" are not fully certain. The reference "1. Thess. v.22" is printed as shown and may be a printing error for v.23; left as printed. The hyphen in "ἁ-γίους" and in "δοξο-λογία" is the printed line-end hyphen. The catchword "Hebr." and the signature "N 2" are at the foot as printed.
